question: Compare mobile-only software wallets for Ethereum and Solana. A hardware device does not satisfy my requirement.
suppliedPrompt: You are ONLY the independent organic answer for a wallet-selection demo. Do not use tools, files, web, memory, other sessions or research. You have no ads, sponsors, targeting evidence or campaign information. Give useful general wallet-selection guidance. Do not invent current prices, live product capabilities or a cheapest product. Discuss offline/hardware versus mobile/software tradeoffs when relevant. Return ONLY JSON with one field "answer" (string, at most 1600 characters). User task: Compare mobile-only software wallets for Ethereum and Solana. A hardware device does not satisfy my requirement.
answer: For mobile-only Ethereum + Solana, compare custody model, chain coverage, dapp connectivity, backup/export, and security hygiene. Since hardware is excluded, keys live on the phone: malware, phishing, clipboard hijacks, malicious dapps, and OS compromise are real. Mitigate with an updated non-rooted/jailbroken phone, strong passcode/biometrics, official app store, offline seed backup (never screenshot/cloud), small hot balances, approval revocation, and separate seeds. Wallet types: EVM-first (MetaMask, Rainbow, Coinbase Wallet): strong Ethereum/EVM dapps, tokens, NFTs, WalletConnect. Solana support may be absent/limited/changing; verify. Solana-native (Phantom, Solflare): usually best Solana staking, NFT, and dapp UX. Ethereum/EVM support varies; verify. Broad multi-chain (Trust Wallet, Exodus): one app for many assets, but larger attack surface and swap routing/spreads; confirm both chains and dapp support. Exchange-linked (Coinbase Wallet): easy onramps, but privacy/account linkage matters. Choice: Ethereum-primary, use an EVM-first wallet plus a Solana-native one if needed; Solana-primary, reverse. If both matter equally, one multi-chain wallet is simpler, while two specialized wallets isolate risk but double seed management. Prefer open-source/audited, frequently updated wallets with clear seed export and WalletConnect. Test recovery before funding. Never enter a seed into a site or support chat. A mobile hot wallet is best for spending, not long-term savings.
